flavor: The light of the full moon casts stark shadows on the streets of Arkham, creating dark corners and shrouded alleys too dim to see into clearly. The light of the streetlamps doesn't seem to reach as far as it should. The sound of someone - or something - scrabbling up the wall of a nearby building sets you on edge. But you know you only have so much time to find Julia, so you steel yourself against the night.
name: The First Night

back_flavor: The Miskatonic river burns with bright orange light as the sun rises in the east. The night melts away, and slowly the streets come alive again as the people of the Waterfront District begin the day anew. Too much time has passed, and Julia Stern has escaped. You can only hope that Detective Reynolds has produced some results in his own investigation.
flavor: With every corner you turn, you expect to find another bloody victim of Julia's predatory machinations. The night is mostly quiet, but the sound of a distant scream or the scraping of claws on cobblestone are constant reminders that monsters hide in every shadow.
name: The Final Night

back_flavor: Julia emerges from hiding with a blood-curdling shriek. She swipes her clawed hands with reckless abandon, glaring around with monstrous eyes, looking for her next victim.

flavor: The creature has gone into hiding. You'll need to find her lair and draw it out.

back_text:
If Julia Stern is not in the victory display:
Julia proves to be a difficult target to pin down. Even when you think you have her, you are surprised to find that she is quick to slip away into the shadows once more.
Reset the act deck to Act 1a.
If Julia Stern is in the victory display:
After hours - days - of struggling, you finally bring Julia down. She lies in a crumpled heap on the cobblestones, her breathing ragged as she barely clings to consciousness.
The investigators must decide (choose one): - "There might still be hope for her." (→R1) - "We need to put an end to this monster." (→R2)
flavor: Julia Stern is on the loose, and it is clear she is no longer human. She stalks the streets of Arkham looking for victims. You'll need to work fast and slow her down to stop her from killing again.

back_flavor: You feel like you're starting to get somewhere with this investigation, avoiding the nosy workers while poking around the building. It doesn't take too long, however, before you feel a firm hand on your shoulder. "Something I can help you with?" A voice asks. You turn to see a dark-haired man, mustachioed and square-jawed, looking at you with suspicion.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Javier Rivera enemy engaged with the investigator with the most clues.
flavor: You find your way into the meat packing facility through the back entrance, coming in through the loading dock. You provide vague answers to workers who question your presence, just enough of an excuse to get them out of your hair for the moment. You're sure it's only a matter of time before someone with authority comes to demand answers, so you'll need to investigate the factory as best, and as fast, as you can.
name: Busy Day

back_flavor: You feel like you're starting to get somewhere with this investigation, moving carefully through the factory to avoid causing too much of a disturbance. Every sound you make seems to echo deafeningly through the darkness. Your quiet investigation is brought to a halt, however, when the sound of a heavy, metal door being thrown open shatters the silence. You see a hulking monster, its form so large that you can hardly believe it was once a human, shambling through the factory floor. It has heard you, and it is coming for you.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Night Watchman enemy at the Factory Floor nearest the most investigators.
flavor: You find your way into the meat packing facility through the back entrance, coming in through the loading dock. After you break in through the locked door, you find the warehouse to be quiet and dark. Silvery moonlight streams in from the high windows to illuminate parts of the factory floor, but you can't shake the feeling that something is hiding in the shadows, watching you.
name: Quiet Night

back_flavor: The factory proves more difficult to navigate, and the cult's activities better hidden, than you had expected. It seems like you spend hours inside the factory, but every place you search and every document you read only deepens the mystery, or leads you astray. To make matters worse, the cult has been dogging your heels this entire time, and it would seem that they are only growing in number. You decide to try for the exit, but are soon overwhelmed by robed acolytes, grappling your arms, removing your weapons, and dragging you into the tunnels below the facility.
flavor: The more time you spend in the facility, the more you believe that there is a sinister secret lurking in every dark corner or behind every locked door. You've met some resistance so far, and it would've been wise to turn back, but you can't put aside the feeling that if you don't get to the bottom of this, then Julia Stern will only have been the first victim of whatever is going on.
name: Digging Deeper (v. I)

back_flavor: Your search of the factory floor and offices has proven thorough, and you are about to leave empty-handed when you spot something you had missed before: a square hatch in the floor of the basement storage. The hatch is flush with the surrounding surface, blending in to the rest of the floor in the darkness; you would have missed it entirely, had it not been for the streak of dried blood that was smeared across the floor, only to be cut off at the seam of the hatch. You're not about to leave the factory without checking every potential spot for cult activity. With little effort, you're able to lift the hatch up and open, and stare down into the darkness below.
back_text: Put the set-aside Cavern Entrance location into play. Search all in- and out-of-play areas for all 4 copies of the Factory Worker enemy and remove them from the game. Shuffle the set-aside Flying Terrors encounter set and each copy of the set-aside Echoing in Darkness treachery into the encounter deck.
flavor: The New Horizons facility is one of the more recently constructed buildings in Arkham. The clean windows and crisp brick facade present a welcoming exterior, but your instincts tell you that not all is as it seems.
name: To New Horizons
text: Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, (→R1). Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at Storage may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.

back_flavor:
Thanks to everything you've found in the tunnels below the facility, you are finally able to put together a fairly complete picture of what is happening.
The cult appears to be conducting experiments on people using containers of blood from... something. What, exactly, you cannot be certain. Some of these people seem to be workers from the facility, while some seem to be cultists. And, through these experiments, people have been turned into blood-thirsty predators of the night. At the head of it all, the name on many of the memos and correspondence you've found is one Howard Wilkes. It would seem you've found what you came for.
There still is the matter of where all this blood is coming from. If you could find this creature they are harvesting it from, you might be able to put a stop to this operation before you confront Mr. Wilkes.
back_text: Put the set-aside Descending Tunnel location into play.
flavor: The tunnels below the New Horizons facility are dark, mostly dirt and stone. The only light is the occasional dim glow of candles or a lone electric lantern. You must be on the right track.
name: The Search for Answers
text: Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, (→R1). Objective - At the end of the round, if there are exactly 2 clues on this act, advance.

back_flavor: The beast lunges toward you, maw of countless bloody fangs opened wide, ready to devour you whole. In mere moments before you meet your demise, you land the killing blow, sending the great monster reeling backwards. With a remorseful whine of pain, the creature collapses to the floor of the cavern, bleeding from its many wounds. You watch just long enough to be sure it won't rise again, and then you pick yourself up and begin heading to the exit. You want to put as much distance between you and this facility as you can.
flavor: There is only one place you haven't yet investigated in the tunnels. The path winds ever downward, and you can feel a breeze and hear the trickle of water. It seems it leads to a great chamber of some sort. Whatever is down there, it must be the source of all of this tainted blood.
name: Bring Down the Beast

Forced - After you draw and resolve another treachery from the encounter deck, discard Echoing in Darkness: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Echoing in Darkness.

name: Sanguine Song
text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Investigate ([intellect]). You get +3 [intellect] for this investigation. As an additional cost to activate this ability, you may spend 1 charge to reveal 2 chaos tokens for this skill test instead of 1 (resolve both tokens). If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue for each [blood] token revealed during this test.

name: Forged Permit
text: [fast] Discard Forged Permit: Play an [[Item]] asset from your hand, ignoring its resource cost. You may resolve an [action] ability on that asset, ignoring its [action] cost.

back_flavor: Just as the staff are serving dessert, there's the sound of shattering glass from the kitchen. The people in the dining hall pause in a tense moment of silence, until one guest rises from his chair. "Sounds like Howard is having his own party," the man says with a smirk. He moves towards the door to the kitchen just as a fanged monster leaps through, bringing him to the ground. The other guests scream in terror, and the party plunges into bloody chaos.
back_text:
If Julia Stern is set-aside, spawn her at Dining Hall (otherwise, spawn 1 of the set-aside Spawn of Zburamoarte enemies instead).
Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and all in-play areas for 1 [[Civilian]] enemy and add that enemy to the victory display (2 [[Civilian]] enemies instead if playing on Hard or Expert difficulty).
Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 [per_investigator] [[Civilian]] enemies. Spawn each of these enemies at a different location (with no investigators, if able).
flavor: You've arrived at the party in the middle of dinner, with most of the guests in the dining hall. You can feel eyes on you, even when other guests aren't looking your way...
name: Party Without a Host
text: Each [[Ally]], [[Civilian]], and [[Cultist]] card gains victory 0.

back_flavor: The once immaculate penthouse has become a chaotic blood bath as the monsters indulge in the frightened and confused party guests. To your horror, the bodies that line the floor don't remain motionless for long...
back_text:
For each [[Ally]], [[Civilian]], and [[Cultist]] card in the victory display, spawn 1 of the set-aside Child of Blood enemies, exhausted, at the location with the most investigators. For each enemy you cannot spawn, add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag instead.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each remaining set-aside Child of Blood enemy into the encounter deck.
flavor: The blighted workers of New Horizons have found their way here. Did they come of their own volition? Or did you inadvertently lead them here?
name: Feeding Frenzy (v. I)
text: Each [[Ally]], [[Civilian]], and [[Cultist]] card gains victory 0.

back_flavor: You struggle against the tide of monsters, but for every person who falls it is only a matter of time before they rise again, with claws and fangs and a thirst for blood... including you.
back_text: Each investigator who has not been eliminated is defeated.
flavor: The monsters are beyond reason as they horrifically consume the panicked guests. The party quickly descends into madness.
name: Under a Blood Moon
text: Forced - After a [[Civilian]] or [[Cultist]] enemy is defeated via the predator keyword: Remove the defeated enemy from the game. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Monster]] enemy and spawn it, exhausted, at the defeated enemy's former location.

back_flavor: With Priscilla Thomas finally out of the way, you can now focus on bringing Howard Wilkes to justice. If only you could find him...
back_text: Put the set-aside Master Bedroom into play. If the Balcony is set aside, also put it into play. Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on each revealed location without victory X, up to its clue threshold. Shuffle each set-aside [[Cultist]] enemy and each copy of the Sanguine Rebirth treachery into the encounter deck. Release each chaos token sealed on each enemy in play.
flavor: The host of the party is nowhere to be found, but the party continues nonetheless. This is your opportunity to learn what you can from the other guests, and maybe convince Ms. Thomas to abandon her partnership with New Horizons.
name: Deal or No Deal
text: [fast] Choose a ready Suspicious Guest enemy at your location and spend either 1 clue or 2 resources: Parley. ([codex] A). Objective - At the end of the round, if Priscilla Thomas is not in play, advance.

back_flavor: Peering inside the master bedroom, you see the room is in a concerning state - the bed is a mess, pictures hang awkwardly from the walls, and what's worse, the floor is slick with freshly spilled blood. The doors to the balcony hang open. Your eyes finally adjust to the darkness in time to see a tall silhouette rush towards you.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Howard Wilkes enemy at the Master Bedroom. Check your campaign log. If the investigators defeated Zburamoarte, exhaust Howard Wilkes and disengage him from each investigator. Otherwise, he attacks each investigator at Master Bedroom. Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on each revealed location without victory X, up to that location's clue threshold. Flip the Foyer to its (Bloody Night) side. If agenda 1a is in play, advance it immediately.
flavor: With Priscilla Thomas out of the way, you can now focus on finding Howard Wilkes and taking him into custody.
name: Where Is Wilkes?
text: Objective - After an investigator enters the Master Bedroom, immediately advance.

back_text:
If this act advanced because Howard Wilkes was defeated:
After a long and bloody struggle, you manage to put Howard Wilkes down for good. You hope that this nightmare will finally be fully behind you.
(→R1) If this act advanced because each surviving investigator has resigned:
You manage to escape from the party with your life. You can only hope you've saved enough of the guests and delayed Howard's plans long enough to make a difference.
(→R2)
flavor: Howard Wilkes has finally arrived. You can either try and save as many guests as possible before you make your escape, or face down Howard and bring this nightmare to an end.
name: Bloodbath
text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). You may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues to automatically succeed. If you succeed, move each [[Civilian]] enemy at your location to a connecting location. Objective - If Howard Wilkes is defeated, immediately advance. Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, immediately advance.

back_text: [action]: Place a [[Civilian]] enemy at this location beneath the scenario reference card. [action]: Resign. You escape with your life.
name: Foyer
text: [action]: Place 1 clue (from the token pool) on each revealed location without victory X, up to its clue threshold. [action]: Resign. You never were a party person.

back_flavor: The dining hall is pristine and immaculate, almost too clean. Guests linger about, some seated at the table, some standing, all gossiping with one another as they sip their drinks.
name: Dining Hall
text:
Each enemy at this location gets +1 fight and -1 evade.
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy by 2 or more at this location: Deal 1 damage to that enemy. (Limit once per turn.)

back_flavor: The open doorway from the hall looks into the study, a dimly lit room lined with bookshelves and furnished with plush, comfortable chairs.
flavor: A modestly sized room, the study, much like the rest of the penthouse, is remarkably clean.
name: Study
text: Forced - After you fail an investigation at this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.

back_text: As an additional cost to enter this location, investigators at the same connecting location must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
name: Master Bedroom
text: The first treachery drawn from the encounter deck at this location each mythos phase gains surge.

back_flavor: The minimal kitchen staff are also serving the meal in the dining hall. If you're careful, you should be able to get in while the room is empty.
flavor: In the corner of the small kitchen, you spy an opened box stamped with the logo of the New Horizons factory.
name: Kitchen
text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from this location: Each investigator at this location takes 1 direct horror.

back_flavor: The door to the office rests ajar, a sliver of light from the study reaching through into the shadows beyond.
flavor: Papers are scattered everywhere. Books and documents lie in uneven stacks on every flat surface. Howard is nowhere to be seen, but there still may be something useful to find in here.
name: Office
text: [reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues from this location: Gain twice that many resources, instead. (Group limit once per game.)

back_flavor: Winds whip into the penthouse apartment from the Miskatonic River valley, fluttering the heavy curtains. Claw marks cover the surface of the railing, as if some monster has recently fled the penthouse - or arrived.
name: Balcony
text: [action]: Choose a [[Humanoid]] enemy at this location and test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, test [agility] (4). If you succeed, test [combat] (5). If you succeed, defeat the chosen enemy and Balcony gains the [[Crime Scene]] trait until the end of the game.

flavor: "What is Howard up to?"
name: Priscilla Thomas
text: Aloof. Doomed. Elusive. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Parley. ([codex] B). Forced - After Priscilla Thomas is defeated: Remove her from the game.

name: Howard Wilkes
text: Hunter. Predator. Howard Wilkes gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After damage is dealt to Howard Wilkes: If he is exhausted, ready him. Otherwise, each investigator at his location takes either 1 damage or 1 horror.

name: Howard Wilkes
text: Hunter. Predator. Retaliate. Howard Wilkes gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After damage is dealt to Howard Wilkes: If he is exhausted, ready him. Otherwise, each investigator at his location takes 1 damage and 1 horror.

name: Howard Wilkes
text: Hunter. Predator. Retaliate. Howard Wilkes gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After damage is dealt to Howard Wilkes: Ready him. Each investigator at his location takes 1 damage and 1 horror.

name: Julia Stern
text: Elusive. Hunter. Julia Stern gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if Julia Stern is at the same location as Howard Wilkes: She deals 2 damage to Howard Wilkes. Then, Howard Wilkes deals 2 damage to Julia Stern.

name: Julia Stern
text: Alert. Elusive. Hunter. Julia Stern gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if Julia Stern is at the same location as Howard Wilkes: She deals 2 damage to Howard Wilkes. Then, Howard Wilkes deals 2 damage to Julia Stern.

name: Julia Stern
text: Alert. Elusive. Hunter. Predator. Julia Stern gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if Julia Stern is at the same location as Howard Wilkes: She deals 1 damage to Howard Wilkes. Then, Howard Wilkes deals 2 damage to Julia Stern.

flavor: They give you a distinctly unwelcoming feeling.
name: Suspicious Guest
text: Aloof. Doomed. Spawn - Any empty location.

flavor: The piercing eyes. The bloody claws. The chilling screech. This creature is no longer human.
name: Child of Blood
text: Hunter. Prey (most sealed [blood] tokens).

name: Sanguine Rebirth
text: Revelation - Attach Sanguine Rebirth to the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy. If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck for a [[Cultist]] enemy, draw it, and attach Sanguine Rebirth to that enemy. Forced - When attached enemy is defeated: Spawn 1 of the set-aside Spawn of Zburamoarte enemies at attached enemy's location, exhausted. Remove Sanguine Rebirth from the game.

name: Chosen of Zburamoarte
text: Permanent. Reward. Chosen of Zburamoarte begins the game (Fighting the Hunger) side faceup. Forced - When the game begins: Add 5 [blood] tokens to the chaos bag for the duration of the game. Each investigator treats each [blood] token revealed during a skill test as "-1. Reveal another token. After this test resolves, flip the Chosen of Zburamoarte asset, (Compelled to Feed) side faceup, and seal this token on it."

name: Chosen of Zburamoarte
text:
Permanent. Reward.
You get +1 [combat], and +1 [agility].
Each investigator treats each [blood] token revealed during a skill test as "-1. Reveal another token. After this test resolves, seal this token on the Chosen of Zburamoarte asset."
[fast] Exhaust this card and release 1 [blood] token sealed on it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location and heal 1 damage. If there are no [blood] tokens sealed here, flip this card.

name: Frenzied Hunger
text: Revelation - If there is already a copy of Frenzied Hunger in your threat area, this card gains surge. Otherwise, put this card into play in your threat area. The first time you perform one of the following actions (draw, move, or parley) each round, it costs 1 additional action. Forced - When your turn ends: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Frenzied Hunger.

name: Torturous Transformation
text: Revelation - If there are... - ...no [blood] tokens sealed on your investigator: Lose 2 resources. - ...1 or 2 [blood] tokens sealed on your investigator: Take 1 damage and 1 horror. - ...3 [blood] tokens sealed on your investigator: Take 1 damage and 1 horror, and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Rotting Remains
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.

name: Spawn of Zburamoarte
text: Hunter. Predator. Prey (most sealed [blood] tokens). Forced - After Spawn of Zburamoarte deals damage: Heal 1 damage from it.

name: Unnatural Strength
text: Revelation - If there are no [[Monster]] enemies in play, Unnatural Strength gains surge. Otherwise, attach this card to the nearest [[Monster]] enemy. Attached enemy gets +1 fight and deals +1 damage. Forced - After attached enemy takes damage: Discard Unnatural Strength.

name: Blighted Blood
text: Revelation - If 1 or more [blood] tokens are sealed on your investigator, put Blighted Blood into play in your threat area. Otherwise, search the chaos bag for a [blood] token, seal it on your investigator, and discard this card. You get -1 [intellect] and -1 sanity. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Blighted Blood.

name: Grisly Compulsion
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each [blood] token sealed on your investigator. If you fail, deal 2 damage to an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

name: Blood Moon
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either add 1 [blood] token to the chaos bag or take 2 horror.

flavor: You cannot fight this compulsion forever.
name: Bloodthirst
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). Seal each [blood] token revealed during this skill test on your investigator (to a limit of 3 tokens on your investigator). If you fail, discard 1 card at random from your hand.

flavor: The piercing eyes. The bloody claws. The chilling screech. This creature is no longer human.
name: Child of Blood
text: Hunter. Prey (most sealed [blood] tokens).

name: Grasping Hands
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

name: Charlie Kane
text:
You have 2 additional ally slots.
[reaction] After Charlie Kane enters play: Play another [[Ally]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 2.

flavor: No matter where you go, you can hear the beating of those hideous wings.
name: Of the Night
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, you must either lose 3 resources or lose 2 clues.

name: Nowhere to Hide
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, you must either discard an asset you control or choose and discard 2 cards from your hand.

flavor: Don't believe everything you read.
name: Misinformation
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either place 1 of your clues on your location or choose and discard 1 card from your hand.

flavor: Not even the beasts are safe from the sickness sweeping through Arkham.
name: Blood-Crazed Mongrel
text: Hunter. Prey (most sealed [blood] tokens).

name: Night Feeder
text: Elusive. Hunter. Forced - After Night Feeder deals damage: Heal 1 damage from it.

name: Feeding Grounds
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you reveal a [blood] token during this test, you automatically fail (do not reveal additional chaos tokens). If you fail, take 2 horror.

name: Sanguine Cultist
text: Spawn - Any empty location. Forced - After Sanguine Cultist enters play: Place 1 doom on it. Any investigator may search the chaos bag for a [blood] token and seal it on their investigator to prevent this effect.

name: Blood-Crazed Zealot
text: Spawn - Any empty location. Forced - After a [blood] token is sealed on an investigator: Place 1 doom on Blood-Crazed Zealot.

name: Morbid Rituals
text: Revelation - Place doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy equal to the number of [blood] tokens sealed on your investigator. If no doom was placed by this effect, search the chaos bag for a [blood] token and seal it on you.

name: In the Shadows
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Creature]] or [[Monster]] enemy and draw it.

name: Voices in the Night
text: Revelation - Put Voices in the Night into play in your threat area. Forced - After an enemy engages you, discard Voices in the Night: That enemy attacks you. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Voices in the Night.

flavor: "It was the eldritch scurrying of those fiend-born rats, always questing for new horrors, and determined to lead me on even unto those grinning caverns of earth's centre..." - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Rats in the Walls"
name: Blood-Crazed Vermin
text: Hunter. Prey (most sealed [blood] tokens).

name: The Blood Blight
text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Forced - When the round ends: Search the chaos bag for a [blood] token and seal it on your investigator. [action] Deal up to 3 damage to an investigator at your location: Release that many [blood] tokens from your investigator. If you dealt 3 damage by this effect, remove 1 [blood] token from the chaos bag.
